upstream.description: An open-source, ontology-based semantic context accelerator that enables AI agents to make more accurate, consistent, and explainable decisions.

classification.analysis: An AWS open-source platform that builds a semantic context layer for AI agents by combining knowledge graphs, formal ontologies, and rule-based reasoning over enterprise data sources. It follows a Scan -> Model -> Serve architecture: ingesting and enriching data sources, inducing ontologies and metrics, then serving context to agents via a Virtual Knowledge Graph (SPARQL federation) and an MCP server, with namespace/role-based access control. Built as a monorepo (Python + TypeScript CDK, Smithy API contracts, React/Cloudscape UI) for engineers wanting more accurate, explainable agent decisions grounded in governed enterprise context.

use_cases.title: Ground AI agent decisions in a governed enterprise knowledge graph
Expose SPARQL-queryable ontologies to agents via MCP
Build a role-based semantic context service on AWS CDK
